CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.PracownikDrzewo(@PRC_GIDNumer int, @Data int, @Poziom int, @Prawa varchar(200) = '') AS BEGIN
SELECT FRS_ID, FRS_ParId, FRS_Nazwa ,CASE WHEN FRS_GIDTyp = 944 THEN ISNULL(Prc_Nazwisko,'')+' '+ISNULL(Prc_Imie1,'') ELSE FRS_Opis END AS FRS_Opis ,FrS_Poziom AS Poziom, FRS_GIDTyp, FRS_GIDNumer, FRS_AktywnyOd, FRS_AktywnyDo ,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT * FROM CDN.PrcRole JOIN CDN.Role ON Rol_Id = PrR_RolId JOIN CDN.RolePrawa ON Rol_Id = RlP_RolId WHERE PrR_PrcNumer = Prc_GIDNumer AND RlP_PraId = 22) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Kierownik FROM CDN.FrsPracownik(@PRC_GIDNumer,@Data,@Data,@Poziom,@Prawa) LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PrcKarty ON Prc_GIDTyp = FRS_GIDTyp AND Prc_GIDNumer=FRS_GIDNumer ORDER BY Poziom, FRS_GIDTyp, Kierownik DESC , FrS_Nazwa
END
